The Philadelphia 76ers (8-2) are 1st in the Atlantic and 1st in the East, have won eight of their last ten, and are coming off a one-game losing streak, going 4-1 at home and 4-1 on the road. The Chicago Bulls (1-7) are 4th in the Central, 5 games back, and 14th in the East, and they enter on a six-game losing streak. The 76ers won the last meeting 126-107 in Philadelphia on November 2, 2026, lead the 2026-27 season series 1-0, and lost the 2025-26 series 1-2.

Out for Philadelphia are Adem Bona (back sprain), Ariel Hukporti (Achilles surgery), and Dominick Barlow (back fracture), while Joel Embiid is day-to-day with plantar fasciitis and a game-time decision. Out for Chicago are Nic Claxton (hamstring strain) and Zach Collins (illness), and Jalen Smith (finger sprain), Norman Powell (shoulder inflammation), and Tobe Awaka (knee sprain) are day-to-day and game-time decisions.
